summary: Independent verification pass on the availability-at-the-source bug fix. Added /app/backend/tests/test_availability_past_complete.py — 14 pytest tests, ALL PASS. Covers: (1) BUG PRIMARY: book future slot via /api/internal/calendar/book → confirm slot is removed from calendar_range open_slots → PATCH complete → re-fetch calendar_range → slot STILL NOT in open_slots (i.e., completed keeps slot occupied); DB verify status='completed' with confirmed_date/confirmed_slot_time unchanged. (2) no_show also keeps slot occupied (same pattern, DB verify status='no_show'). (3) Past times excluded: today's open_slots contain no time earlier than now (America/Toronto); past-date open_slots == []; patient GET /api/availability/slots returns no past times and no times colliding with confirmed/rescheduled/completed/no_show docs. (4) Endpoint guards: POST /api/internal/calendar/book past date → 400 'past'; past time TODAY (11:30 vs now 13:12 EDT) → 400 'past'; PATCH /api/internal/appointments/{id} action=reschedule into past working-day date → 400 'past'; POST /api/portal/appointments with past option → 400 'past'; POST /api/portal/appointments/{id}/reschedule into past → 400 'past' (seeded via portal create + staff approve to future >24h, then reschedule to past). (5) Future genuinely-open slot still books happily and disappears from open_slots. (6) Availability snapshot: GET /api/admin/availability document is byte-identical before vs after entire suite; recurring break 15:00 never leaks into any working day's open_slots. FRONTEND UI REGRESSION (Playwright, staff login): /internal/calendar Day/Week/Month toggles all render; Month shows past days greyed with existing appts, BLOCKED days (Sep 29/30 Wed, Oct 1 Thu) show 'BLOCKED' badge with pre-existing confirmed appts (e.g., '13:00 Lopez' on Sep 30 BLOCKED) still visible; Week view shows 28 cal-complete buttons and 10 cal-open-slot entries on future working days; Today (Tue Sep 22) shows no open_slots (all AM in past + all PM booked), confirming the past-time cutoff is honoured live. MANDATORY CLEANUP executed: module-scope autouse fixture deleted every CREATED appointment_requests id (7 created this run) plus its appointment_reminders and the touched patients' notifications (title 'Appointment confirmed') + outbound_notifications (subject 'Appointment Confirmed — Dr. Aguayo'). Post-run DB check: only 15 leftover TEST_ appts remain from PREVIOUS iterations' 'set_type' run (NOT this iteration) — none of our IDs remain. GET /api/admin/availability document unchanged. No production data touched. 'approve' action deliberately has no past-guard — per spec, not flagged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_busy_slots() (L744-755) now correctly includes status in ['confirmed','rescheduled','completed','no_show'] with confirmed_date != None — this is the root-cause fix and behaves per spec. Uses confirmed_slot_time when set else _norm_time(confirmed_time), matching how books are written.

availability.py _now_cutoff/_slots_for_day/generate_slots/calendar_range all pass the cutoff tuple; is_past_slot() is a thin wrapper used by every write endpoint. Past-whole-day short-circuits to empty slots and today's slots iterate filtering t<now_min — correct.

Guards present at every write path: create_appointment L620, select_slot L660 (409 as spec — patient choosing from stale offered_slots), patient_reschedule L726, calendar_book L890, internal reschedule L1450. 'approve' L1428 intentionally has no past guard (confirms a requested time not availability pick) — matches spec.

Minor observation (not a bug): select_slot returns 409 for past slot while other write endpoints return 400. This is intentional (409 = 'no longer available' for stale offered_slots) but callers should treat both 400 and 409 as 'pick a new time'.

Not from this iteration, but the previous cleanup missed them for the 'requested' status ones. Not blocking; can be swept by main agent with a one-liner: db.appointment_requests.deleteMany({reason:/^TEST_/}).
